title: The whores would be just coming out of their houses making ready for the night, yawning lazily after their sleep and settling the hairpins in their clusters of hair.
html_source:
The speaker specifically says that the whores… ready for the night, immediately marking a relatively apparent feature—that they sleep during the day to prepare for their “work.”

This separates them from others of society, perhaps in an attempt to reinforce the point of Stephen’s sin-loving soul being strange and regrettable.
